name: card-deck-crafter-v2-monorepo
description: Monorepo para Card Deck Crafter v2

scripts.docker:volume:backup: docker run --rm -v cdc2_data:/data -v ${PWD}:/backup alpine tar czf /backup/cdc2_backup.tar.gz -C /data .
scripts.docker:volume:restore: docker run --rm -v cdc2_data:/data -v ${PWD}:/backup alpine sh -c "rm -rf /data/* && tar xzf /backup/cdc2_backup.tar.gz -C /data"
